plan_summary: Authenticate with Spotify using Supervisor-provided credentials, paginate through matching albums, inspect every song in the uniquely matched album, select the unique minimum-play-count song, play it, verify the selected identity and mutation response, then complete the task.

steps.reasoning: The public documentation for every API needed by the task must be inspected before any task API is called.
steps.action_code:
required_api_docs = [("supervisor", "show_profile"), ("supervisor", "show_account_passwords"), ("spotify", "login"), ("spotify", "search_albums"), ("spotify", "show_song"), ("spotify", "play_music"), ("supervisor", "complete_task")]
public_api_docs = [apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name=app_name, api_name=api_name) for app_name, api_name in required_api_docs]
verification_targets: Public documentation is loaded for every task API before its first use.

steps.reasoning: Spotify credentials must be obtained from the Supervisor APIs and kept private before logging in.
steps.action_code:
supervisor_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
account_passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_password_records = [record for record in account_passwords if record["account_name"].casefold() == "spotify"]
assert len(spotify_password_records) == 1
spotify_username = supervisor_profile["email"]
spotify_password = spotify_password_records[0]["password"]
spotify_login = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_username, password=spotify_password)
spotify_access_token = spotify_login["access_token"]
verification_targets: Exactly one Spotify credential record is selected.
A Spotify access token is stored without printing credentials or tokens.

steps.reasoning: All pagination pages for the instructed album-title query must be read before choosing an album.
steps.action_code:
album_query = "Echo Chamber Chronicles"
album_page_limit = 20
album_page_index = 0
all_album_results = []
while True:
    album_page = apis.spotify.search_albums(query=album_query, page_index=album_page_index, page_limit=album_page_limit)
    all_album_results.extend(album_page)
    if len(album_page) < album_page_limit:
        break
    album_page_index += 1
print([{"album_id": album["album_id"], "title": album["title"], "artists": album["artists"], "song_count": len(album["song_ids"])} for album in all_album_results])
verification_targets: Every result page for the album query is collected.
Only public album candidate information is printed.

steps.reasoning: The target album must be selected from the real paginated results using the exact title stated in the instruction.
steps.action_code:
exact_album_matches = [album for album in all_album_results if album["title"].casefold() == album_query.casefold()]
assert len(exact_album_matches) == 1
selected_album = exact_album_matches[0]
assert len(selected_album["song_ids"]) > 0
print({"album_id": selected_album["album_id"], "title": selected_album["title"], "artists": selected_album["artists"], "song_count": len(selected_album["song_ids"])})
verification_targets: A unique exact-title album is selected from observed results.
The selected album contains at least one song ID.

steps.reasoning: Determining the least listened-to song requires reading the public details and play count of every song in the selected album.
steps.action_code:
album_song_details = [apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id) for song_id in selected_album["song_ids"]]
print([{"song_id": song["song_id"], "title": song["title"], "album_id": song["album_id"], "album_title": song["album_title"], "play_count": song["play_count"]} for song in album_song_details])
verification_targets: Details are retrieved for every song ID belonging to the selected album.
Public song identities and play counts are available for selection.

steps.reasoning: A separate pre-mutation review must derive the unique minimum-play-count song and confirm it belongs to the selected album.
steps.action_code:
assert len(album_song_details) == len(selected_album["song_ids"])
assert all(song["album_id"] == selected_album["album_id"] for song in album_song_details)
minimum_play_count = min(song["play_count"] for song in album_song_details)
least_listened_candidates = [song for song in album_song_details if song["play_count"] == minimum_play_count]
assert len(least_listened_candidates) == 1
selected_song = least_listened_candidates[0]
assert selected_song["song_id"] in selected_album["song_ids"]
print({"song_id": selected_song["song_id"], "title": selected_song["title"], "album_id": selected_song["album_id"], "album_title": selected_song["album_title"], "play_count": selected_song["play_count"]})
verification_targets: All inspected songs belong to the selected album.
The chosen song is the unique observed minimum by play count.
The mutation song ID is derived solely from prior public API results.

steps.reasoning: The reviewed song ID can now be passed to Spotify to play the requested song.
verification_targets: Spotify receives only the derived song ID as the playback target.

steps.reasoning: After playback, a fresh public song read and the mutation response must be checked against the pre-mutation selection before task completion.
